title: Administration services access should be restricted to specific IP addresses
description: Administration interfaces should only be accessible from trusted IP addresses. Exposing these services to the public internet increases the risk of unauthorized access and potential compromise.
message: Restrict access to administration services to specific IP addresses only.
impact: If administration services are accessible from any IP, attackers can attempt to gain unauthorized access, increasing the risk of data breaches and system compromise.
recommendation: Configure network rules or firewall settings to allow access to administration services only from trusted IP addresses.

noncompliant.description: The administration service (e.g., SSH) is open to all IP addresses.

compliant.description: The administration service is restricted to a specific trusted IP range.

devsecops.compliance: Relevant for compliance frameworks requiring restricted access to sensitive services.

why_is_this_an_issue: Unrestricted access to administration services exposes the system to brute-force attacks and unauthorized access attempts.
how_to_fix: Restrict access to administration interfaces by configuring firewall rules or security groups to allow only trusted IP addresses.
